title.en: Holy Places between Mecca and Medina
title.rurdu: Makka o Madina ke darmiyaan ki Ziyaraat
title.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

desc.en: Out of those holy places which are on the way to Medina from Mecca like the graves of the martyrs of Fakh near Masjid-e-Taneem, grave of Abdullah bin Abbas in the Valley of Taif, the grave of Maimunah, the wife of the Holy Prophet (s) which is two farsakhs away from Mecca in Saraf, graves of Hawwa (s) in Jeddah and Aamena in Abawa, Masjid Ghadeer-e-Khum near Juhfah (two to three miles away from Juhfah), grave of Abu Zar-e-Ghiffari in Rabza, graves of the martyrs of Badr in Badr, grave of Abdullah bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib who was martyred while returning from the Battle of Badr due to severe wounds and is buried in Rawha which is 17 km. away from Medina.
desc.rurdu: Woh muqaddas ziyaraat jo Madina aur Makkeh ke darmiyaan hai, jaise keh Shohoda-e-Fakh jo Masjid-e-Taneem ke qareeb hai, Abdullah ibne Abbas ki qabr jo Waadi-e-Taif mein hai. Qabr-e-Maimunah, zauja-e-Rasool (s) jo Saraf, Makkeh se 2 farsakh ki duri par hai. Qabr-e-Hawwa (s) jo Jeddah mein hai aur Qabr-e-Aamena (s) jo Abawa mein hai. Masjid Ghadeer-e-Khum jo Juhfah se 2 ya 3 mile ki duri par hai. Qabr Abuzar-e-Ghiffaari jo Rabza mein hai, Qabr Shohoda-e-Badr jo Badr mein hai. Qabr-e-Abdullah bin Haaris bin Abdul Muttalib jo Badr se laut-te waqt shadeed zakhmi hone ki bina par shaheed huwe aur unki qabr Rawha jo Madine se 17 km. ki duri par hai.

desc.en: It is three miles away from Juhfah and two miles away according to another tradition. Late Shaykh Sadooq has written in Man La Yahzarul Faqih a tradition from Imam Sadiq (a.s) that it is recommended to pray in Masjid Ghadeer-e-Khum.
desc.rurdu: Masjid Ghadeer-e-Khum, Juhfah se 2 ya 3 mile ki duri par hai. Shaikh Sadooq ne apni kitaab Man La Yahzarul Faqih mein Imam Sadiq (a) se riwaayat ki hai keh mustahab hai is masjid mein namaz padhe.

desc.en: Abawa is a name of a village 13 miles from Juhfah. Lady Aamena (s) binte Wahab, the mother of Holy Prophet (s) was returning from Medina to Mecca after visiting the grave of her husband Abdullah (a) when she fell ill and passed away here. Her grave is famous in Abawa. It is recommended to recite the Ziyarat of <Lady Aamena (s)> at this place.
desc.rurdu: Abawa, Juhfah se 13 mile ki duri par hai. Bibi Aamena (s) binte Wahab, jo Rasool-e-Khuda (s) ki maadar-e-giraami hai, woh apne shauhar Abdullah (a) ki ziyarat karke Madine se Makkeh ki taraf laut rahi thi, raaste mein woh bimaari huwi aur unki wafaat ho gayi. Unki qabr mubarak Abawa mein mashhoor hai, Mustahab hai keh is jagah par ziyarat <Bibi Aamena (s)> zaroor padhe.
